stem: The straight line $\overleftrightarrow{AB}$ passes through the points $A({=x1}, {=y1})$ and $B({=x2}, {=y2})$. Find the slope of any straight line parallel to $\overleftrightarrow{AB}$.
solution: Parallel lines have equal slopes, so the slope of any line parallel to $\overleftrightarrow{AB}$ is ${=m}$.
notes: Entry skill: compute slope from two points; parallel lines share it. Integer slopes only.
